Definition: from the same as G3350; to transfer as a settler or captive, i.e colonize or exile:--carry away, remove into.
BiblicalUsage: Abraham leaves the land of the Chaldeans and dwells in Haran, and later Stephen says God will carry the people away beyond Babylon. The word is the settling of a people in a new land, whether by God's leading or by His judgment.
TheologicalSignificance: I notice that God moves His people both ways with this word: Abraham is carried into the land of promise, and Israel is carried beyond Babylon, and in both cases the move is God's doing.
